inspector.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
inspector.help: Add this component on the avatar root (same object as VRCAvatarDescriptor). ATO analyses mesh UVs and shrinks / atlases Texture2D islands so VRAM goes down without changing how the avatar looks.
inspector.generateAtlas.help: On: pack used UV islands into atlases. Off: only scale whole textures and tweak import settings.
inspector.npot.help: Use 64 px steps instead of powers of two. Compatible with MipStreaming and Crunch. PVRTC is removed from iOS options.
inspector.whitelist.help: Any referenced Texture2D is skipped entirely. Other textures that share the same UV skip atlasing only.
inspector.platform.help: Auto follows the current build target. Tick an override to edit that platform.
error.noDescriptor.title: ATO must sit on VRCAvatarDescriptor
error.noDescriptor:description: Move Avatar Texture Optimizer onto the avatar root that has VRCAvatarDescriptor.
error.noDescriptor:hint: The component only runs when it is on the same object as the descriptor.
error.multiple.title: More than one ATO component
error.multiple:description: An avatar and its children may only have one Avatar Texture Optimizer. Extra components: {0}
error.multiple:hint: Remove the extra components and keep a single one on the avatar root.
error.cancelled.title: ATO cancelled
error.cancelled:description: Bake / build was cancelled. Temporary assets on disk were kept. CPU / GPU / memory were released.
error.cancelled:hint: Run the bake again when you are ready.
error.fatal.title: ATO stopped
error.fatal:hint: See the [ATO] console log for details.
warn.uvWrap: UV crosses a wrap seam or cannot be normalized into [0,1]. Treated as whitelist: {0}
warn.shader: Shader could not be analysed safely. Treated as whitelist: {0}
warn.atlasFit: A single texture / UV group cannot fit the largest atlas. Atlasing skipped: {0}
warn.grayFormat: A gray texture still has multiple used channels, so a multi-channel format was kept: {0}
warn.alphaFormat: A transparent atlas cannot use a format without alpha. Fell back to a safe format: {0}
warn.pvrtc: PVRTC is not valid for NPOT atlases and was removed from the iOS options.
warn.st: Texture has ST / scroll / rotation (material or animation). Treated as whitelist: {0}
report.title: ATO finished
